file_impact.reason: Adds the operation-based POSIX named-semaphore probe: attempts a real sem_open and classifies the result, so denial is detected by behaviour rather than by inspecting the host.
Wires the requires_posix_named_semaphore marker into the existing capability-probe and counted-skip framework established by 985f.
New tests covering the probe's available and unavailable verdicts, including the falsification case that a probe hardcoded to unavailable must fail.
